component.name: ScreenGuard
component.summary: Digital Wellbeing, Daily Time Limits & Focus Mode for Linux

description.p: ScreenGuard brings active Android-style Digital Wellbeing, App Limit Lockouts, and Focus Mode Pomodoro Session Blocking directly to the Linux desktop.

ul.li: Digital Wellbeing Dashboard with 30-day cumulative trends
Interactive 7-day bar chart with week-by-week history navigation
Daily App Limits with 90% warning alerts and 100% lockout screen
Focus Mode with animated Pomodoro countdown timer and distraction blocker
